svg.title: Bank teller — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as bank teller, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A banknote and round coin sit above a service-counter line beside two short cash-stack edges. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: a ponytail, a softly squared face.
